messages.author: f5d9089b910c7092
messages.subject: Persistent sessions
parts:
I tried posting this in the thread called 'Persistent R sessions" (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/persistent/shiny-discuss/g5FbYp5Iyj8/WLb-UDtAxgsJ) but it got deleted.

I have shiny 0.7.0 running on an Ubuntu 12.04.2 LTS machine. When I launch an app using Chrome browser, three processes get created. However, when I close the browser window, the three processes persist. The processes don't end until I manually kill them using sudo killall R. Because of this issue a few apps that use Sys.Date() to popualte dateInput() are not refreshing the date. For example, if I clear all processes using the killall command and launch the app today, it will show today's date (9/30/2013) correctly. Now if I close the browser and launch it again tomorrow, it will show 9/30/2013 instead of tomorrow's date (10/1). If I then kill the processes, it will show tomorrow's date correctly. 

The discussion in the "Persistent R session" thread was about this problem occurring in Ubuntu 13.04. Does anyone know why this might be happening in 12.04.2 LTS?

Thanks!
